name: Therysil
summary: At the Shrine of Aessina in central Ashenvale, Therysil waits for word of her sister. The dryad is devoted to protecting nature, but Therylune has been taken by the Twilight's Hammer cultists.

sections.title: A Guardian's Vigil
sections.body: Therysil keeps watch near the waters of the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale's ancient woods. As a dryad and daughter of Cenarius, she is bound to defend the wild and its spirits. Her thoughts now turn to Therylune, captured nearby by the deranged Twilight's Hammer cult. Therysil waits anxiously for a wandering ally who can help rescue her sister.

faq.answer: Therysil is a dryad who dwells at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale. She is a daughter of Cenarius and Therylune's sister.

Therysil fears for her sister, Therylune, whom Twilight's Hammer cultists ambushed and captured at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore. She waits at the shrine, hoping someone can guide Therylune safely home.
Therylune is Therysil's sister and a dryad of Ashenvale. The Twilight's Hammer captured her, and she needs an escort to escape and reunite with Therysil.
Find Therysil at the Shrine of Aessina, a sacred natural haven along the roadway in central Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a daughter of Cenarius, Therysil reflects the close bond between the Cenarion Circle and Ashenvale's natural spirits. Her plight is especially urgent for visiting druids.
Dryads have long stood with the kaldorei to safeguard Ashenvale's sacred groves, including the Shrine of Aessina.
